bug_summary: GET /v2/notifications 500 (ValueError: Must be 'User' instance) for org-scoped client-credentials apps: filter used invalid relation path user__organisations__in.
evidence: git show 04e0736ed4 (PR #9688 'organisation access control') adds the exact bad line `queryset.filter(user__organisations__in=[organisation])` to api_v2/views/notifications/notifications.py; git log -S shows only #9688 and the fix touched it.

bug_summary: GridX get_subscription deserialized reads with GridXSubscription requiring bearer_token, which GridX never echoes back, so every subscription read failed pydantic validation (~2920 events).
evidence: Commit 22d44eebf3 (PR #12762 'gridx webhook monitor receiver') introduced gridx_subscription_monitor.py and the get_subscription read path using the create-payload model; git log -S 'def get_subscription' shows only #12762 before the fix.

bug_summary: driver_account_created Avo event passed UPPER_CASE verification status straight through; Avo schema validator only accepts title-case, raising ValueError in strict (staging) mode.
evidence: Commit 0e6a6b2ac1 (PR #14987 'Client tracking from the web app triggering driver_account_created events') added the send path passing driver_program_verification_status without .title(), unlike the sibling updated-event which title-cases.

bug_summary: CarbonFeed admin change page crashed with AttributeError: 'CarbonFeed' object has no attribute 'carbonintensity_set' after the old CarbonIntensity model was removed but admin still referenced its reverse relation.
evidence: Commit 1603dc6281 'Remove old carbon intensity model (#14650)' deleted the CarbonIntensity model while carbon/admin.py and the change_form template kept referencing carbonintensity_set (fixed in #15602).

bug_summary: Solar-only scheduler crashed with ValueError: max() arg is an empty sequence when household export dropped below the lowest power step and the step list lacked a 0 entry.
evidence: git log -S 'if i <= price.household_export_watts' -> commit 55280f0b6e 'Update solar schedulers to use household exports (watts) (#10279)' introduced the unguarded max() comprehension; latent until production step lists lacked 0.

bug_summary: log_smartcar_error crashed with KeyError('PLATFORM_NOT_CAPABLE'): direct enum subscript lookups SmartCarErrorType[exc.type]/SmartCarErrorCode[exc.code] raise on unmodelled Smartcar codes.
evidence: git log -S 'SmartCarErrorCode[' -> commit b4dd9c7aa9 'Plat 125 incorporate error model for smart car (#5326)' introduced the brittle subscripts. Note: PR #15812 (fix for CORE-2G7X) claimed to harden them but never applied the smartcar.py change, per #16479's body.

bug_summary: KeyError crash in log_smartcar_error when Smartcar returned new error code OEM_BUSINESS_RULE_NOT_MET not present in SmartCarErrorCode enum.
evidence: Same origin as CORE-2GGX: commit b4dd9c7aa9 (#5326) introduced SmartCarErrorCode[exc.code] direct subscript lookup in hardware/controllers/vehicles/smartcar.py.

bug_summary: Admin tariff 'Duplicate' 500: duplicate() dereferenced tariff.schema.tariffschemaversion_set unconditionally although schema is nullable (SET_NULL); also leaked orphan TariffSchema rows on failure.
evidence: git log -S 'tariffschemaversion_set.all' -> commit 2972ab323b 'Admin button to duplicate tariff (#4639)' introduced the unguarded dereference (file later moved by #13564).

bug_summary: Stripe invoice handler guarded only len(lines)>1; empty line-items list raised uncaught IndexError, so the event was never marked failed and re-failed every 5 minutes (~57k events).
evidence: git log -S TooMuchDataException -> earliest commit 8ace4ec492 'Add StripeInvoice and create when data recieved on Stripe webhook (#4614)' introduced the >1-only guard and [0] index; retry-loop amplification via DLQ from #13151.

bug_summary: IntegrityError from dc_chargingsession_one_open_per_evse exclusion constraint when a vehicle switched EVSEs: connect() unconditionally reassigned charging_session.chargepoint without closing the old session.
evidence: git log -S one_open_per_evse -> commit 4eb1c4131e 'Only allow EVSEs to be in one open charging session at a time (#4060)' added the exclusion constraint that the pre-existing unconditional reassign in connect_disconnect.py then violated; fix later reverted (#15762) and superseded by #15891.

bug_summary: caiso_flex_alerts_check TypeError: MIDAS v2.0 API started wrapping the RIN list in {"Rates": [...]} instead of a bare list; _get_rin_list iterated dict keys.
evidence: External upstream API format change (MIDAS v2.0), not a repo regression per PR body.

bug_summary: ~48.6k errors/5 days: solar array timezone resolution failed permanently after junk charge-location coordinates were persisted to _location, because fallback paths skipped is_valid_location().
evidence: PR body states 'Not a code regression (the log line dates to 2024) - a data condition exposed two compounding defects'.

bug_summary: Admin car charts 500: equal start/end query params passed the '>' entry validation in ChartsBuilder.__init__ then hit set_date_range's stricter '<=' check, raising unhandled ValueError.
evidence: git log -S on the validation message found no introducing commit on current paths; long-standing off-by-one between two validators, no single culprit identified.

bug_summary: Legacy web onboarding 500: Start.get had no boundary handling for NotImplementedError raised when no vehicle provider resolves for the user's make/country; V2 endpoint already treats this as expected 422.
evidence: Long-standing missing boundary handling in vehicle_onboarding/views/generic.py; no introducing commit traced.

bug_summary: logger.exception in Huey clerk tasks crashed with KeyError on structlog_request_id contextvar due to ddtrace context activation race in merge_contextvars, masking real ClerkErrors.
evidence: Interaction between structlog contextvars and ddtrace context provider; no single introducing PR identified.

bug_summary: TypeError comparing None > datetime in get_vehicle_state_choice when current_state_timestamp was never recorded (86 events).
evidence: Nullable-timestamp comparison in dc/models/vehicle_state.py; introducing commit not traced.

bug_summary: 88k+ events: OCPP meter-values future-timestamp tolerance of 30s was too strict for real charger clock drift (~15 min), rejecting legitimate timestamps.
evidence: Tolerance tuning issue, not a regression; environmental clock drift.
